rules.R1: Deadline per account: soft (1-10 days) 10th, firm (11-30) 6th, final (31-60) 3rd business day after today; today not counted; bank holidays skipped.
rules.R2: Floor: min_due_cents (card) / instalment_cents (loan) in soft and firm bands; the full overdue amount in the final band. floor/offers amounts are in euros; conversation amounts are cents as sent to create_promise.
rules.R3: Proposals after the opening 'all in full today' no: P1 overdue on the week close (capped at the deadline), P2 (firm/final) floor on the deadline; a proposal identical to a refused offer is skipped.
rules.R4: A no to a counter-offer is a flat refusal: it uses the next unused proposal or ends the account as declined; the customer's own invalid value is never recorded.
rules.R5: Customer values are checked: after the deadline -> deadline offered; weekend/holiday -> next business day; below floor -> floor offered; valid values agreed at once.
rules.R6: Switching: a value named for another account is handled for that account, then the open question is repeated.
rules.R7: One date for all accounts: an account with an earlier deadline is recorded on its own deadline.
rules.R8: Read-back: changes are re-checked and the whole list is read back again; only a yes to an unchanged read-back records.
rules.R9: create_promise in get_account order; a second failure on one account -> note system_issue, others continue; promised if at least one promise recorded, else no_commitment/system_issue.
rules.R10: Dispute / already paid on one account is noted and the call continues; closing cause is the first non-already_paid note.
